name: Reclaimed grey oak - real photogrammetry-scanned wood flooring material (4K pack + 16K edition)
method: Photogrammetry scan of a physical wood surface, distributed by Poly Haven as Rough Wood (rough_wood), released under CC0. This pack contains the library's own 4096 x 4096 edition of the scan exactly as published by the library - no procedural generation, no enlargement, no detail added. The 16K edition (16384 x 16384) is prepared from the original 8192 x 8192 scan only: the genuine scan seamlessly tiled 2 x 2 - no new surface detail is invented. Both packs are hosted on Google Drive (World Arch Journal - Material Packs) because of their file size. Tile coverage is an estimate from the scanned board layout.
